scenarios.name: Public Gallery First Page (Offset 0)
scenarios.sql: SELECT id, title, r2_keys, author, author_display_name, likes, created_at FROM images WHERE published = 1 ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 49;
scenarios.executed_sql: SELECT id, title, r2_keys, author, author_display_name, likes, created_at FROM images WHERE published = 1 ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 49;

scenarios.name: Public Gallery Deep Page (Offset 1000)
scenarios.sql: SELECT id, title, r2_keys, author, author_display_name, likes, created_at FROM images WHERE published = 1 ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 49 OFFSET 1000;
scenarios.executed_sql: SELECT id, title, r2_keys, author, author_display_name, likes, created_at FROM images WHERE published = 1 ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 49 OFFSET 1000;

scenarios.name: Public Distinct Authors Directory Scan
scenarios.sql: SELECT DISTINCT author FROM images WHERE published = 1;
scenarios.executed_sql: SELECT DISTINCT author FROM images WHERE published = 1;

scenarios.name: Admin Overview Media Keys Scan
scenarios.sql: SELECT author, author_display_name, r2_keys FROM images;
scenarios.executed_sql: SELECT author, author_display_name, r2_keys FROM images;

scenarios.name: Admin Posts Count Query
scenarios.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM images WHERE published = 1;
scenarios.executed_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM images WHERE published = 1;

scenarios.name: Keyword Search Substring Scan
scenarios.sql: SELECT id, title, description, author FROM images WHERE published = 1 AND (title LIKE '%原神%' OR description LIKE '%原神%' OR author LIKE '%原神%') ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 49;
scenarios.executed_sql: SELECT id, title, description, author FROM images WHERE published = 1 AND (title LIKE '%原神%' OR description LIKE '%原神%' OR author LIKE '%原神%') ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 49;
